findings.impact: In real browsers files is empty at dragenter and types already holds 'Files' whenever files exist, so the term is almost certainly inert. It is still an unrequested edit to the existing upload overlay path.

findings.claim: The text-query results page now always renders an UploadZone wrapper div (`relative flex-1 flex flex-col`) around its content, including while image search is unavailable, whereas before this change it returned the content with no wrapper.
findings.impact: With image search unavailable, I7 says the text-query page behaves exactly as before. findings.claim: The in-zone 'enabled' state is not reset when it turns false mid-drag: dragClassRef and dragCounterRef keep their old values, because the handlers are detached rather than cleaned up.
findings.impact: If availability flips while a drag is over the page, which is very rare because it is resolved once per drive, a later drag could start with a stale class. Single-user use makes this negligible.
findings.evidence: UploadZone.tsx:158-170 removes the handlers with no reset of the refs; the reset happens only in handleDragLeave and handleDrop.

bucket_proposal.reason: Needs a timing coincidence, and no declared invariant is broken in normal use.

trajectory: The design is being patched. Round r2 added the boolean prop acceptUpload to UploadZone, with a guard in handleDrop, to keep upload-class drops from uploading on the search page. This round (5addec5e1) adds a second boolean prop, enabled, plus a conditional on handlers, an attribute and an effect. All of it keeps one zone component imitating 'no zone' on the search page. The zone now has three independent modes: one-image, upload and inert. Each fix added a branch or a state so the zone could behave like the absent one. This round did remove two branches: FolderBrowser's `if (!onImageQuery) return inner` early return, and GlobalSearch's conditional dropEffect. The net trend is still more flags on UploadZone, not less. The simpler design would be a separate search-page drop target for image drops that leaves UploadZone untouched.
